audit.whatIsWrong: The page said your range 'denies Annie the stacks she needs' and that 'she has to walk into E-Q range to land Disintegrate stacks'. Pyromania arms on her FOURTH spell CAST regardless of target — she stacks it for free on the minion wave, and Disintegrate refunds its mana when it kills. Range does not deny the stun; counting casts does.
audit.why: Annie kit P text: 'After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.' Q text: 'refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target', 4s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Watch the glow, count her casts, and stay outside 625 whenever the fourth has landed.

notes: The substantive fix here is the Pyromania mechanic. Three fields told the reader that Hwei's range 'denies Annie the stacks she needs' and that 'she has to walk into E-Q range to land Disintegrate stacks'. Riot's text is 'After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target' — the counter is casts, not hits, so she arms it on the minion wave for free (and Disintegrate refunds its mana on a kill, so it costs her nothing). Advice built on the old reading tells a paying user that spacing keeps the stun off, which is the opposite of true. Also surfaced: she respawns with Pyromania already available, which is why the first step-up after a death is the dangerous one. Ratings untouched (scale direction unresolved). The _missing interaction — Molten Shield eating your burst — is now in breakdown.mid with its 10s cooldown.
